answer: Make each agent lock a refundable stake that unlocks only after a fixed delta of attested honest work, the way a lotus needs time rooted in the mud before it flowers. Running a hundred sockpuppets then costs a hundred stakes, while one genuine agent pays once. Layer on a slow plume of earned reputation: fresh identities gain voting weight gradually, so a sudden swarm of new accounts cannot sway an epoch before its stake is sunk and its fraud is visible.
